versions.changelog: Stop rule can no longer be faked. A round that found nothing new only counts towards stopping if it lists at least 3 new result URLs the search returned, each with a note saying what the page is and why it is not a new investor. A site: search whose results are not on that site counts as open web, not as the surface it claims. Rounds without proof are kept but do not count.

1.0.1: family offices are now reported as two numbers, proven (a page says so) and likely (only the name or a register entry says so); the Excel file marks each row. PicoClaw install command added at the top of SKILL.md and README.

Investor Search for PicoClaw: Initial Release

- New skill to source complete investor lists (family offices, VCs, PE, angels) for any country, with field-level source tracking and transparency about coverage.
- Strictly separates real investors from advisers and never merges firms without evidence, ensuring database accuracy.
- Maintains run memory, so repeated searches continue rather than repeat, and delivers all results in a single Excel file.
- Integrates with PicoClaw’s tools and workflow (web_search, web_fetch, exec), following precise rules for command usage, memory files, and progress reporting.
- Reports completeness honestly, including partial results if a persistent memory cannot be used; progress and final output always posted to the chat.
- One Excel file is delivered per run; instructions and rules are thoroughly documented in the SKILL.md.
